groups_badge_whole.name: groups_badge_whole
groups_badge_whole.value:
("groups"."badge_tag" is null) = ("groups"."badge_color" is null)
        and ("groups"."badge_tag" is not null or "groups"."badge_emoji" is null)

profiles_read_own_and_added.name: profiles_read_own_and_added
profiles_read_own_and_added.using:
"profiles"."user_id" = (select auth.user_id()) or exists (
        select 1 from friends
        where friends.follower_id = (select auth.user_id())
          and friends.followee_id = "profiles"."user_id"
      )
